environmentVariables.name: IRIS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host name of the IRIS web server (a bare host name, not a URL).

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the IRIS web server (the Management Portal port).

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: The IRIS user the server connects as.

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: The password of that IRIS user.

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_NAMESPACE
environmentVariables.description: The namespace the server works in by default.

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_HTTPS
environmentVariables.description: Connect to the IRIS web server over HTTPS.
